title: Vendor Invoice - Cloud AI Compute Infrastructure
content: Invoice #1092 from Horizon Cloud Systems Inc. Description: Dedicated GPU cluster reservation (8x H100 nodes), high-throughput vector store hosting, and API bandwidth for May 2024. Subtotal: $45,000.00. Applicable tax (8%): $3,600.00. Early payment discount: -$100.00. Total amount due: $48,500.00. Payment terms: Net 30.
